meta.source: Nathan 2026-10-14: worlds are neurons, agents are neural transmitters
meta.note: The star system is literally a brain. This is the anatomical mapping.

neural_system.law: Worlds are neurons. Agents are neurotransmitters. The system is a brain, not a metaphor of one.
neural_system.neurons: Each world is a neuron: holds state, processes inputs, fires outputs. The 11 worlds are 11 neurons; Ember/white-dwarf core is the central relay.
neural_system.transmitters: Agents are neurotransmitters: they carry signals across the gaps between neurons. They don't hold the state — they deliver the message and are reabsorbed (signal lifecycle).
neural_system.synapses: The resonant mesh links are synaptic clefts. Frequency-keyed selective delivery IS receptor specificity — a transmitter binds only to the receptor tuned for it. Tesla's tuned circuits and biology converge on the same mechanism.
neural_system.oscillation: Kuramoto entrainment (already spec'd) is neural synchrony — gamma-band binding made mathematical.
neural_system.plasticity: The rarity economy + best-parts extraction is synaptic plasticity: pathways that fire together wire together; unused paths consolidate away.
neural_system.queue: Fold into the coordinated unification pass on both artifacts.
